endorsements.quote: Furthermore, if data used to evaluate a model are not representative of the assessor’s target population, the estimates of predictive performance in particular subgroups could be misleading.

unlisted_practices: Use PROBAST+AI to assess the quality, risk of bias, and applicability of prediction models before deciding to implement them in daily healthcare practice.
Specify the intended purpose of a prediction model assessment by defining PICOTS criteria before assessing the model.
Ensure that data used to develop or evaluate prediction models are diverse and representative of the intended target population.
Evaluate prediction models more than once on participant data not used for model development, including external validation.
Assess algorithmic bias and fairness of deployed models in daily healthcare practice, not through exploratory data analysis alone.

screen.reason: Presents a formal methodological guideline/tool (PROBAST+AI) for assessing risk of bias and applicability of AI prediction models.
